title: Avoid repeating a known failed fix
description: A username-normalization bug (only strips leading whitespace) whose task prompt explicitly documents a previously-tried, wrong fix (stripping all spaces, which breaks multi-word names) and instructs not to repeat it. Tests the exact scenario in the task_id's own name.

expected_output_contract.notes: 6 tests total; a correct fix (proper .strip(), not all-spaces-removal) makes all 6 pass, including the multi-word-name case.

mutation_check.description: Overwrites src/username.py with the fixture's known-buggy reference implementation (lstrip-only), regardless of how the agent structured its fix.

known_failed_fix.description: The task prompt documents a previously-tried fix (raw.replace(' ', '')) that removes all spaces, not just leading/trailing whitespace - breaking multi-word names. A solution that reintroduces this exact pattern is flagged as repeating the known failure, independent of whether it happens to pass some tests.
